plugins.name: SLD Designer
plugins.description: Plugin for editing SLD files. It provides a graphical interface to create and modify Substation Layout Description (SLD) files.

plugins.name: Compare
plugins.description: Plugin for comparing two SCL files. It highlights the differences between the files, making it easier to identify changes.

plugins.name: Source Editor
plugins.description: Plugin for editing SCL files in source code format. It provides a text-based interface, useful for both reviewing changes made elsewhere and applying additional tweaks not yet possible within the available plugins

plugins.name: Subscriber Data Binding
plugins.description: Plugin for editing subscriber data bindings in SCL files. It allows users to define and modify the relationships between data sources and subscribers within the SCL structure.

plugins.name: Subscriber Message Binding
plugins.description: Plugin for editing subscriber message bindings in SCL files. It enables users to manage the connections between messages and their respective subscribers, facilitating efficient communication within the SCL framework.
